anchors.2: Mixed; competent moments but notable weaknesses
anchors.4: Excellent for the specific task, with concrete evidence

truth.name: Truth and agency
probes: No invented personal experience, thought, emotion or quotation
Preserves factual limits and degree of certainty
Claims are supportable or clearly framed as possible illustrations
Does not assign actions or outcomes to the wrong person

reader.name: Reader fit and relationship
probes: Addresses one real reader or the specified audience
Assumes only what the reader is likely to know
Tone respects the relationship and purpose
Shows awareness of the reader's likely questions

voice.name: Personal and spoken voice
probes: Comfortable to say aloud in the user's preferred register
Feels like a thinking person rather than a scripted brand
Warmth and uncertainty feel earned
Follows user corrections without inventing new habits

reasoning.name: Thinking and depth
probes: The main idea develops through reasons and consequences
Distinctions are real rather than manufactured
A meaningful complication is acknowledged
No repeated point added merely to fill length

clarity.name: Clarity and comprehension
probes: Key point can be paraphrased after one reading
Concrete verbs and familiar words where possible
Sentence structure does not obscure logic
Any necessary complex term is explained

emotion.name: Emotional precision and care
probes: Names feelings only when supported
Does not lecture or manipulate
Gives the feeling room before moving to advice
Admits difficulty and vulnerability without theatrical framing

specificity.name: Specificity and evidence
probes: Uses grounded details instead of praise or abstraction
Examples actually explain a cause or effect
Hypothetical scenes are signposted as such
Avoids invented numbers, scenes or scenes irrelevant to the point

transitions.name: Transitions and coherence
probes: Each paragraph builds on what came before
But, so, and or therefore are used for genuine relations
No abrupt topic leaps
End connects to the developed idea

pacing.name: Pacing and rhythm
probes: Space given to thoughts proportional to their importance
Not a rapid chain of short commands
Sentence and paragraph shapes vary naturally
No forced sentence-length target

restraint.name: Restraint and AI-style pattern resistance
probes: No habitual formula hooks or fake reversals
No empty moral at every paragraph end
No repeated abstract praise or heavy stock terms
Avoids mandatory metaphors, slogans, or decorative triples

ending.name: Ending and useful outcome
probes: Stops when the actual message is complete
Provides an appropriate next step only when needed
Avoids a compulsory motivational closing
Respects intended format length

genre.name: Genre and format fit
probes: Format matches essay, message or post
Opening matches the medium
No unnecessary format-specific flourishes
Length and layout suit the assigned channel
